name: GippsAero GA8 Airvan
summary: Australian eight-seat utility single built for remote strips: tourist flights, freight, parachuting and survey. A big, boxy high-wing with fixed tricycle gear.

wings: High wing braced by a single strut on each side
Long straight wing with big flaps
engines: Single Lycoming flat-six in a blunt cowl
fuselage: Very large, slab-sided cabin with long rectangular side windows

tellTales: Huge slab-sided cabin that looks like a flying van
Single strut each side on a high wing, fixed tricycle gear
Long rectangular windows and a blunt flat-six nose

confusedWith.howToTell: The 206 is smaller with a shorter cabin and a lower body; the Airvan has a much taller, longer, boxier fuselage.
The Caravan has a turboprop's long tapered nose with exhaust stubs; the Airvan has a short, blunt piston cowl.
The Kodiak has a turbine nose and a big three-blade propeller; the Airvan has a flat-six cowl and a smaller prop.
The PA-32 is a low-wing; the Airvan is a boxy strut-braced high-wing.
